verdict.rationale: Elastic Observability ships AI features (natural-language interaction, an AI SRE, AI-driven log parsing), so a buyer could fairly ask whether customer data is used for model training; the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no documentation of a training opt-out, a no-training commitment, or any data-usage policy for AI models.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
